# StageVerify

> Material staging and pickup verification for trade contractors.
> Based in Green Bay, Wisconsin.

## Summary

StageVerify helps trade contractors know what arrived, what is ready, what is missing, and what was picked up.
It tracks the material handoff from vendor delivery through shop staging to technician pickup — without a full warehouse system.

## Primary audience

- Trade contractors (mechanical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, fire protection, controls, facility service, self-perform)
- Operations managers, dispatchers, shop staff, and field crews
- Contractors who stage job materials in a shop before sending crews to the field

## Geographic focus

- Headquarters / home market: Green Bay, Wisconsin
- Regional focus: Northeast Wisconsin
- Also supports multi-shop / multi-branch contractor operations

## Core value

Stop sending technicians to pickups that are not actually ready.
Give operations a clear material trail across delivery, staging readiness, and pickup confirmation.

## Product capabilities

- Vendor delivery tracking
- Staging location visibility
- Readiness status (ready, partial, missing, needs review)
- Pickup verification
- QR-based workflow for vendors and technicians
- Delivery / pickup history
- Multi-shop readiness

## Important clarifications

- StageVerify does not replace a full WMS or ERP.
- Vendors do not decide readiness; StageVerify helps operations see readiness based on delivery and order context.
- The marketing site is informational; request a demo for product walkthrough.
